$comment: Settings of the Customizer: one table per settings file/category. customizer.sh builds its *_TWEAKS arrays from it (key|type|args|label); the overlay gets type/args through `list`. Labels and sections are English; i18n/<lang>.json translates them.

tables.comment:
Параметры Bar Tweaks: ключ|тип|аргументы|подпись. Дефолты совпадают с BarSkin.qml:
у num последнее число, у enum первое слово, у color/bool — сами аргументы.

items.label: Workspaces: pill under the active one

tables.comment: Параметры экрана блокировки (Lock Tweaks) — те же типы, файл lock-design.json.
Настройки переходов обоев — строки tweak:<key> в категории Wallpaper FX.

Живые обои — owe (движок обоев Omarchy, видео / GIF). Customizer пишет owe.json, tweak_ops.owe_after
собирает из него ~/.config/owe/config.toml и зовёт owe reload-config.

items.label: Live wallpaper: pause under a fullscreen window
Live wallpaper: pause when any window is open (saves power)
Live wallpaper on battery: play · pause on the current frame · still poster
Live wallpaper: programs that pause it while running (comma separated, e.g. obs, steam)
Live wallpaper: GIF frame rate after transcoding
Live wallpaper: fade of stills (battery poster), ms

tables.comment:
Вид пикера тем и обоев — строки tweak:<key> в категории Theme Switcher.
0 / -1 = значение из стиля-пресета или темы (ключ в файле тогда не хранится).
Виджеты рабочего стола (плагин kamradsmeshnyavy.widgets) — файл widgets.json.

items.label: Desktop widgets: on / off (off — anchored ones are not drawn; free and floating stay)
Home screen on an empty workspace: clock, greeting, 3×3 tiles
Home: layout — auto (by the rice) · glyph (as in glyph-rice) · classic (tiles in the centre) · minimal
Home (glyph): tiles in order — weather calendar cpu ram battery temp disk cava (1 cell), player network (2), system (3)
Home (glyph): cards — auto (by the rice) · flat as in glyph-rice · in the style material
Home (glyph): weather, battery and network line
Home: dot grid in the background
Home: hide anchored widgets while it is shown
Deck: dashboard slides up from the bottom edge on hover (as in glyph-rice)
Deck: layout — auto (by the rice) · panel (as in glyph-rice) · compact strip · full screen
Deck: open — dwell (rest at the edge) · bump (touch the edge, back off a little, hit it again)
Power menu — auto (by the rice) · edge (strip at the screen edge) · glyph (column of Doto words and an uptime ring, from glyph-rice)
Super+Ctrl+V clipboard — auto (by the rice) · stock (Omarchy) · glyph (Clip from glyph-rice: filters, pins, preview card)
Super+M panel — auto (by the rice) · drawer (DOT-MATRIX settings drawer) · quick (Quick from glyph-rice: Wi-Fi / Bluetooth lists, tiles, recording)
Deck: sections in order — clock weather perf net media
Deck: card — auto (by the rice) · flat as in glyph-rice · in the style material
Deck: hover delay at the edge, ms
Widgets: look (style — follows the Customizer style)
Edge hotzones (top — dashboard, top-right — settings, bottom — launcher)
Margin from the bar / frame to the cards
Merge cards with the bar / frame: a card at its edge sits flush and joins it (Vitreus)
Clock (vitreus): layout — rule (hours over minutes) · pipe (12 | 34) · digital (12:34)
System: style — rings · vitreus (monitor card: rings and network graph)
Network: interface, ↓ / ↑ and a dot scope
Todo / notes (click — done, right click — delete, + — add)
Quote of the day (click — next; your own: ~/.config/omarchy/widgets-quotes.txt)
GitHub: contribution graph (needs a GitHub user)
GitHub: user name (the public contributions API gets only this name)

tables.comment: OSD (клон kamradsmeshnyavy.osd): громкость/яркость у края экрана или стоковой карточкой — osd.json.

items.label: OSD: style (edge — slides out of the screen edge / frame)
Follow the bar style (colour, alpha, border, radius)
Attach to the edge (auto — only to a solid bar / frame)

tables.comment: Уведомления (клон kamradsmeshnyavy.notifications): общая подложка у бара или стоковые карточки.

items.label: Notifications: style (drawer — one panel glued to the bar and the edge)
Follow the bar style (colour, alpha, border, radius)
Attach to the bar (auto — only to a solid bar at the edge)

tables.comment: Звуки интерфейса (omarchy-sound + play-sound.sh): уведомления, громкость, окна, воркспейсы — sounds.json.

items.label: Follow the bar style (colour, alpha, border, radius)
Attach to the bar (auto — only to a solid bar at the edge)
Glyph: signal red on critical alerts
Glyph: rising beams on charger plug-in

tables.comment:
Режим чтения (scripts/reading-mode.sh) — reading-mode.json. Строки во вкладке «Шейдер» под «Режим чтения»;
при изменении во время чтения скрипт перепекает шейдер и перезагружает Hyprland.

items.label: Dark theme as a page: auto (invert when dark) · paper · invert
Screen brightness while reading, % (0 — don't touch)
Theme while reading (empty — keep the current one)
Flat windows: no gaps, black 1 px border, square corners

tables.comment: Стиль DOT-MATRIX (dot-matrix) — dotmatrix.json, его читает dotmatrix/Palette.qml в каждом плагине.

items.label: DOT-MATRIX: palette (theme — omarchy colours, mono — original black & white)
DOT-MATRIX: lit LEDs, sliders, active toggles

tables.comment: Что применять из пресета — preset-apply.json. Выключенный раздел пресет не трогает.

items.label: Presets: apply window geometry (gaps, borders, rounding, shadow)
Presets: apply bar skin and layout
Presets: apply wallpaper transition and picker
Presets: apply system fonts of the preset's style
Presets: apply panel surfaces (shadows, motion, material, corners, typeface)

tables.comment: Что применять при смене стиля — style-apply.json. Ключи — как у пресетов, с префиксом style.

items.label: Styles: apply window geometry (gaps, borders, rounding, shadow)
Styles: apply bar skin and layout
Styles: apply wallpaper transition and picker
Styles: apply system fonts (terminals, GTK, browser)
Styles: apply panel surfaces (shadows, motion, material, corners, typeface)
Styles: theme (current — same brightness as the theme now · off · dark · light)

tables.comment:
Углы окон. Скругление — правилом окон, а не decoration.rounding: оно сильнее общей настройки и
переключателя Omarchy «без отступов», и тайловую сетку можно оставить сплошной (её внешние углы и так
скругляет рамка экрана). float — плавающие и pop-окна, all — все, off — как в конфиге Hyprland.
Вкладка «Окна» (windows.json, применяет hypr/customizer.lua и restore): поверх геометрии стиля.
Значения по умолчанию — как в looknfeel.lua dotfiles; стиль при применении пишет сюда свою геометрию.

items.label: No gaps (Omarchy): windows flush to the edges, no borders
Tiling layout: dwindle (spiral) · master (one big window)
Rounded windows: floating only · all · off
